commands:
echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none} ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-none}"
RUNID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"
echo "RESOLVED_RUNID=$RUNID"
mkdir -p ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1301/$RUNID"
echo "$RUNID" | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1301/runid.txt

echo "=== AC1 at PR HEAD: tracked docs/ outside internal|external ==="
git ls-tree -r --name-only 67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82 -- docs/ | grep -vE '^docs/(internal|external)/' || echo "(empty - AC1 satisfied)"
echo ""
echo "=== execution-file-shape.observed.txt location at PR head ==="
git ls-tree -r --name-only 67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82 -- lib/test/fixtures/ | grep -i 'execution-file-shape' || echo "(not in fixtures)"

for f in CLAUDE.md install.sh .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/actions/vendor-plugin/vendor-slice.sh; do
  echo "=== $f: bare docs/<name> refs (should be none outside internal/external/site) ==="
  git show "67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -noE 'docs/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.(md|txt|png)' | grep -vE 'docs/(internal|external|site)/' | grep -vE '^[0-9]+:docs/(external|internal|site)' | head -15 || true
done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; echo "=== docs/internal exists, docs/ root .md files at head ==="; git ls-tree -r --name-only 67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82 -- docs/ | grep -vE '^docs/(internal|external)/' | head -30; echo "=== count ==="; git ls-tree -r --name-only 67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82 -- docs/ | grep -vE '^docs/(internal|external)/' | wc -l

git ls-tree -r --name-only 67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82 -- docs/ | grep -vE '^docs/(internal|external)/' | head -30; echo "COUNT:"; git ls-tree -r --name-only 67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82 -- docs/ | grep -cvE '^docs/(internal|external)/'
git ls-tree -r --name-only 67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82 -- docs/ | grep -vE '^docs/(internal|external)/' | cat; echo "DONE"

git show 67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82 --stat --name-only | grep -E 'docs/internal/' | sed -E 's#.* => ##; s#\}##' | sed -E 's#docs/internal/##' | sed 's#^#internal: #' | head; echo "=== list internal docs at head ==="; git ls-tree -r --name-only 67ac579e0fe0e7dec8501e3949dabde0deaebb82 -- docs/internal | sed 's#docs/internal/##' | head -80

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
